# VEU AI Studio — Portfolio Health Report

**Date:** 2026-05-05
**Org:** veu-ai-studio
**Method:** `/api/configuration/clone` against each flagship product. Captures via Browserless (full JS render); architecture + improvement plan generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6.
**Cost:** $0.218 across all five runs ($0.065 + $0.061 + $0.045 + $0.048 + retry attempts; ReachSMS failed at DNS layer with no Claude calls).
**Total wallclock:** ~290 seconds across the five product captures (sequential).

---

## Executive summary

Five products audited. The portfolio is **bimodal**: two products (SAIGE, PressAI) are credible, structured, and demo-ready waitlist/funnel pages with quality scores in the 70s. Two products (MyBirthSafe, RelTwin) are returning **placeholder/error states** at their public URLs and failed clearance with single-digit scores. One product (ReachSMS) failed at DNS resolution — domain is not reachable.

**Bottom line:** SAIGE and PressAI are **the only two products currently in front of any external visitor with a coherent product story**. The other three are either down, unpublished, or pointing at non-existent domains. This is a critical portfolio-level governance issue: 60% of the flagship URLs in our seed registry are not serving real product experiences right now.

| Product | URL | Status | Quality | Decision | Cost | Critical Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SAIGE | saigedemo.com | ✅ live | **74** | CLEARED | $0.065 | Form below the fold suppressing waitlist conversion |
| PressAI | ourpublishingai.com | ✅ live | **72** | CLEARED | $0.061 | No social proof / customer logos — credibility gap |

## Product cards

### 1. SAIGE — score **74/100** — CLEARED

- **URL:** https://saigedemo.com (browserless, JS rendered)
- **Title:** "SAIGE | Enterprise Impact Performance Platform"
- **Pitch:** "SAIGE unifies ESG, Sustainability, SDGs, EHS and CSR into a single Enterprise Impact Performance (EIP) score — giving leaders the tools to act responsibly across People, Planet, Peace, Progress and Profits."
- **Primary objective:** Capture early-access waitlist sign-ups (email, organisation, role) before full launch.

**Top opportunities:**
- **P0 conversion** — Surface early-access form above the fold (currently buried at bottom of long scroll). Add sticky-header CTA.
- **P1 trust** — Add named customer logos / case studies; the page leans on KPMG/MIT/Deloitte/Gartner stats but has no first-party evidence. Without them, enterprise buyers risk dismissing as vaporware.
- **P1 design** — Replace stock animation widget with a real demo screenshot or embedded interactive preview.

**Top risks:**
- Pre-launch positioning + no live screenshots may signal "unfinished" to a CFO or sustainability lead doing diligence.
- No pricing visibility means GTM motion is unclear (self-serve? enterprise? both?).

**Run ID:** `clone_mos40r0u_xxx` (saved under product_id `saige`).

### 2. PressAI — score **72/100** — CLEARED

- **URL:** https://ourpublishingai.com (browserless, JS rendered)
- **Title:** "PressAI — From Idea to Global Impact"
- **Pitch:** Agentic AI Publishing Platform that takes any person/organization from concept to published, distributed, and monetized knowledge.

**Top opportunities:**

### 3. MyBirthSafe — score **2/100** — NOT CLEARED ⚠

- **URL:** https://safe-path.base44.app (browserless, JS rendered)
- **Title:** *(none)*

**Top issues:**

### 4. RelTwin — score **4/100** — NOT CLEARED ⚠

- **Title:** "RelTwin"
- **Headline rendered:** "Your app is waiting to shine!"

**Top issues:**

**Recommended action:** Update product_id `reachsms` in the registry with the correct URL or change its status to `draft`. Then re-run `/api/configuration/clone`. Currently this product cannot be governed because there is nothing to govern.

## Portfolio-level findings

### Pattern 1 — Hosting fragility on Base44

Two of five products (MyBirthSafe, RelTwin) are returning Base44-host artifacts (error JSON, "waiting to shine" placeholder) instead of product. This is the same root cause: dependency on a hosted-builder runtime that doesn't fail closed gracefully when an app is unpublished or retired.

**Recommendation:** Add a Self-Renewal cron job (`/api/self-renewal/check`) that runs nightly against every product URL. Any clearance < 30 should page the on-call operator via Resend (when activated). Tomorrow's `INNGEST_*` activation makes this a 5-minute setup.

### Pattern 2 — Trust signals lacking on the live products

Both currently-live products (SAIGE, PressAI) scored CLEARED but Claude flagged "lack of customer logos / case studies / live demo" as the **single biggest opportunity** in both improvement plans. This is a portfolio-level pattern: VEU is investing in problem framing and pricing tiers but underweighting third-party validation.

**Recommendation:** Build a single shared "trust component" (logo wall + 2–3 named customer testimonials + a live demo screenshot per product) and rotate it through SAIGE, PressAI, and any newly published products.

### Pattern 3 — Registry hygiene

The seed registry in `src/pages/ProductRegistry.jsx` listed **all five products as `status: 'active'`**. Reality: 2 active, 2 unpublished, 1 unreachable.

**Recommendation:** Add an automated daily job that runs `/api/configuration/clone` against every product where `status: 'active'` and demotes any with `quality_score < 30` to `status: 'broken'` automatically (with a human-review gate before any demote becomes permanent). This is exactly what the Self-Renewal capability is for.

## Reproducing this report

```bash
ORG=veu-ai-studio

for url in \
  "saige|https://saigedemo.com" \
  "pressai|https://ourpublishingai.com" \
  "mybirthsafe|https://safe-path.base44.app" \
  "reltwin|https://reltwin.com" \
  "reachsms|https://ourcommunitiesai.com"; do
  IFS='|' read -r SLUG URL <<< "$url"
  curl -s -X POST https://flowai-dun.vercel.app/api/configuration/clone \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "x-flowai-org-id: $ORG" \
    -d "{\"url\":\"$URL\",\"product_id\":\"$SLUG\",\"org_id\":\"$ORG\"}" \
    --max-time 180 > "/tmp/$SLUG.json"
done
```

Or via the orchestrator (async + poll):

```bash
RID=$(curl -s -X POST https://flowai-dun.vercel.app/api/orchestrator/run \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-flowai-org-id: $ORG" \
  -d "{\"agent\":\"clone\",\"payload\":{\"url\":\"https://saigedemo.com\",\"product_id\":\"saige\"}}" \
  | jq -r .run_id)

# First poll drives the work via pull-resume; blocks ~60-110s and returns completed.
curl -s "https://flowai-dun.vercel.app/api/orchestrator/run?run_id=$RID" --max-time 120
```
